title: Hawker Bakes Keycap Clicker
description: A slice missing from the pandan chiffon reveals its green crumb. Swap the cake for a fluted egg tart with a golden custard centre. Both press onto the same kopitiam saucer switch.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm base · 31.2 mm chiffon · 31.6 mm tart across
printNote: The colour 3MF includes a saucer and two caps. Already have the Kopitiam Clicker? Print just a cap and press it onto your existing full-height MX-style switch. Match pandan green, golden brown, custard yellow and jade to your AMS Lite spools. Test the stem fit before use.
